title: Authority Grant
description: Authority granted to one caller for one capability, within limits, until an expiry (RFC-0023 phase 3), made through authority grant changes. A policy with requireAuthorityGrant decides a request only when its authenticated caller holds a grant in force and the request is within its limits. Nothing is deleted: a revoked grant stays listed.

grantId.description: The changeId of the approved grant change that created it.

callerId.description: The callerId of the API key the grant is for.

limits.description: Limits on the request, by Intent path: target or parameters.<name>. min and max (inclusive) apply to a number there; oneOf lists the only values allowed there. A request whose value is missing, of another type, or outside a limit is NOT_AUTHORIZED.

validFrom.description: From when it holds: the proposal's validFrom, or the approval time.

validUntil.description: Until when it holds. After this, requests are refused as AUTHORITY_EXPIRED.

status.description: At most one active grant per caller and capability. Active says not revoked; check validFrom and validUntil for whether it is in force.

revokedByChangeId.description: revoked only: the approved change that revoked it.
